- Read prior progress log for codex; it was empty.
- Opened improve-code-boundaries skill and confirmed it requires checking found_smells first and finishing one smell fully.
- Next: inspect found_smells, choose one boundary issue in src/ or tests/, then edit and verify with lint/tests.

- Found queued smell files in improve-code-boundaries; choosing the HA postgres-state projection smell in src/ha/worker.rs.
- Reason: it looks like a contained smell-1 case where one helper discards data and another reconstructs it from DCS.
- Next: inspect smell-1 guidance, current HA worker/state types, and tests before editing.

- Confirmed the current code has two postgres-state helpers: one projection plus one DCS repair helper.
- Planned reduction: fold the DCS fallback into a single derivation point and stop using the projection helper where direct PgInfoState matching is enough.
- Next: inspect Make targets and git status, then patch src/ha/worker.rs and the matching unit test.

- Patched src/ha/worker.rs to remove build_local_postgres_state and fold the DCS upstream fallback into build_postgres_state.
- Also changed self-peer eligibility to match PgInfoState directly instead of routing through PostgresState.
- Next: inspect the patch for correctness, run formatting/lint/tests, then delete the processed smell file if verification passes.

- Verified the patched sections in src/ha/worker.rs.
- Running cargo fmt first, then the required make lint and make test gates.
- If verification passes, next steps are delete the processed smell file, commit, push, and run task_switch.

- make lint and make test are both in flight.
- Waiting on verification output before touching git state or the smell queue.
- Next: if either gate fails, fix the issue and rerun; if both pass, delete the processed smell file and ship the task.

- make lint passed.
- The first make test failure was caused by me running lint and test concurrently against the same cargo target dir.
- Rerunning make test sequentially now; if it passes, proceed with smell-file deletion and git steps.

- Sequential make test is still running after the initial build-contention failure.
- Waiting for the full nextest result before deleting the smell file or committing.
- Next: handle any real test failure, otherwise finish the git/push/task-switch sequence.

- Verification passed: make lint clean, make test passed on sequential rerun (233 passed, 16 skipped, 5 leaky).
- Deleted the processed found_smells marker for the HA postgres projection smell.
- Next: review status/diff, commit only the HA worker change plus required .ralph updates, push, and run task_switch.

- Reverted an unrelated fmt-only change in src/ha/decide.rs so the commit stays scoped.
- Ready to stage only src/ha/worker.rs, the processed smell deletion, and current .ralph updates.
- Next: create the commit, push it, then run .ralph/task_switch.sh per instructions.

- Created commit 645b00b (Flatten HA postgres state projection).
- The repo post-commit hook ran docs publish and completed successfully.
- Next: verify git status, push HEAD, then run .ralph/task_switch.sh.
